# Senja Fjord Tours

> Private boat tours from Finnsnes — the gateway to Senja, Norway's wildest island.

Senja Fjord Tours runs private boat experiences departing from Finnsnes harbour, Troms, Norway. All tours are exclusively private — no shared groups, no strangers. The vessel is a 20-foot boat, stable and comfortable, with a covered cabin and all required safety equipment. Pricing is NOK 2 000 per hour.

## Tours

- [Eagles & Lines](https://www.senjafjordtours.no/eagles-and-lines/): Flexible 3–6 hour summer fishing trip on the inner fjord between Finnsnes and Senja. Fish finder on board. Cod, saithe, haddock and halibut in the water. Sea eagles common in the area. Up to 5 guests. Season: May–September. Optional shore visit for filleting at extra cost.
- [Senja Fjord Explorer](https://www.senjafjordtours.no/senja-fjord-explorer/): 6-hour private fjord cruise along Senja's dramatic coastline. Sea eagles, mountain scenery, hidden bays unreachable by road. Season: May–September.
- [Midnight Sun Cruise](https://www.senjafjordtours.no/midnight-sun-cruise/): 3–4 hour evening voyage under the Arctic midnight sun. Departs around 10–11pm. Season: late May to mid-July.

## Journal

Notes and editorial writing about northern Norway and why the less obvious places are usually the best ones.

- [Senja, Not Lofoten](https://www.senjafjordtours.no/blog/senja-not-lofoten/): Why Senja offers everything Lofoten promises with a fraction of the crowds.
- [The Midnight Sun Nobody's Photographing](https://www.senjafjordtours.no/blog/midnight-sun-on-the-water/): What the midnight sun is actually like on an empty fjord at 11pm.
- [Fishing for Real, Not for a Photo](https://www.senjafjordtours.no/blog/fishing-for-real/): The difference between a genuine fishing experience and a packaged tourist product.

## Location

Finnsnes, Troms county, Norway. Approximately 2 hours by car from Tromsø airport. Connected to Senja island by the Gisund Bridge.
